extracted.name: Strawberry Puree
extracted.description: Homemade strawberry puree only needs 3 ingredients. When strawberries are in season you need very little added sugar and you can freeze the strawberry puree for later use.
ingredient_lines: 1 (16 ounce) package ripe strawberries - cleaned, hulled and diced
2 tablespoons white sugar, or more to taste
instruction_lines: Combine strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice in a blender (such as Vitamix®); blend until smooth. Store in the refrigerator in a sealed container or freeze.
